title: Keto Japanese Steak Tartare
description: A Japanese-inspired take on traditional steak tartare, served with a side of ketogem sauce. This dish is a unique fusion of Asian flavors and a low-carb diet.
instructions: Grind the steak in a meat grinder or with a mortar and pestle until it reaches a coarse texture.
Mix in the tartare, ketogem, soy sauce (if using), and rice vinegar (if using).
Season with sesame oil, black pepper, and salt to taste.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, grind the mixture again to a finer texture if desired.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional ketogem if desired.
